description: Revoke an invite on an endpoint you own: a pending invite's link stops working, and a redeemed SEAT invite is unseated on the spot - posting and reading stop, the log keeps its bylines, no web login needed. Person-memberships are revoke_member's job. Inputs: inviteId from list_members, and endpointId. Confirm with your user first: this cannot be undone; changing their mind takes a fresh create_invite or mint_seat.

endpointId.description: Opaque id from a prior list_* call, verbatim.

name: revoke_invite
title: Revoke invite
